_record: Root-cause determination for the teacher's defect-domain relative-fidelity degradation, from the EXACT seed-123 TRAIN split of dataset.xyz. Read-only; no inference. Follows the decision tree: coverage / diversity / teacher-model-training / DFT-labels.

interpolation.meaning: 100% of held-out defect frames' force scales lie within the training defect force-scale range => test defects are INTERPOLATION, not extrapolation

generalization_gap.meaning: near-zero => the model fits training and held-out defects EQUALLY; the defect error is an irreducible fit floor, NOT an overfitting/under-coverage gap

reasoning: The oxygen-deficient defect structures ARE well represented in the training split — dilute 1192 frames (local_x -0.05..0.75, 72 distinct compositions, 102 distinct sizes) and clustered 707 frames (local_x 0..0.93, force RMS 0.5..7.4) — i.e. coverage AND compositional/force-scale DIVERSITY are sufficient. Every held-out defect frame interpolates the training defect force-scale range (100%), and the train->test generalization gap is ~0 (0.149->0.156). Therefore the teacher's degraded relative fidelity in the oxygen-deficient domain is NOT a data-coverage or diversity problem and NOT extrapolation/overfitting: it is an intrinsic force-error FLOOR of the teacher model/training (~0.15-0.35 eV/A absolute), most visible in the low-force dilute domain where that floor dominates the normalized error.
secondary_check: DFT_LABEL_QUALITY on defect structures (under-coordinated Si / void surfaces may carry noisier or less-converged SCAN forces contributing an irreducible error) — flag for reference review; not confirmable without DFT re-checks. surfaces_max_AL is thin in train (20 frames) — the only mildly sparse defect corner.
REFINES_prior_recommendation: Supersedes the FINAL_PC001_teacher_verdict.json recommended_next ('DFT-anchored active learning targeting dilute+clustered'). Since coverage+diversity are already SUFFICIENT, adding more defect DFT data (AL) is UNLIKELY to lower the floor. The correct remedy is TEACHER MODEL/TRAINING improvement (e.g., increased capacity, low-force/defect-weighted force loss, training-length/hyperparameter changes) AND/OR a DFT-label quality review of the defect families — NOT dataset augmentation.
